rationale: Severity 2: not 'blocking' language but a genuine integrity problem — the vendor's own pages disagree with each other (76% vs 71%). Strategic 3: if the category's headline metric can't be trusted at face value, every other capability claim inherits that doubt — this is as foundational to customer support as the trust-boundary themes are to coding.

rationale: Severity 1: a cost/planning problem, not a safety or correctness one. Cost 3: explicitly quantified (2-5x), and named as the top reason evaluated teams look elsewhere. Strategic 2: a major buying-decision factor but doesn't bear on whether the agent performs correctly once deployed.
